sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 560. Success value 100. 3x magic damage (Dark).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 130. Prohibits Unison for 60 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Insanity for 40 seconds with a success value of 110.
-Target: all enemies. Activates Time Slice which reduces the time advantageous effects (buffs, special buffs, and non-removable buffs) are applied to the target by 60 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Protection for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; increases DEF and MDEF by 100%; nullifies status ailments, debuffs, and buff removal effects. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 17000
Paralysis and Blind Resistance Up by 50
